notes: Modified cash basis school district (FY ended 8/31/2025). Fund balance roll-forward from Exhibit III (Total Governmental Funds, includes School Nutrition, Activities, Student Fee, Depreciation, Bond, Special Building and General); no separate business-type funds, so business_type is null. Balance sheet is Exhibit I (modified cash basis net position; Cash and Deposits + County Treasurers' Balance; no liabilities). Receipts and disbursements are Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column. Local Receipts split into categories using the fund schedules (computed, see items); County Receipts split into fines and ESU (p12); Debt Service 230,940 split principal/interest per Bond Fund schedule (p19). Transfers in/out 94,049.31 (57,500 Nutrition + 36,549.31 Activities) are printed below the receipts/disbursements totals so reported_totals exclude them. Non-Revenue Receipts 66,137.31 include a 60,000 Depreciation Fund 'Allocation from General Fund' with no matching General Fund transfer out (see decision_needed); the General Fund schedule's transfers (8000) are only the 94,049.31. Detail: General Fund spending taken from Schedule M (program x object, more detailed) and not from Schedule B (same program totals, skipped to avoid double counting); Schedule A-1 summary and Schedule N (County Treasurer's general fund, a duplicate of Schedule A tax receipts) not recorded. Schedule M object lines have no budget by object; budgets only at program totals (not recorded). Schedule M Other Property Services mapped to professional/contract services and Other Items to dues, training and travel (judgment). Detail Schedule C/F/G transfers/allocations shown as other financing (included in those schedules' printed Total Receipts). Read pages 1-31 of 31
